data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 2.6m (2013: GBP 0.7m) net of reinsurance were made from prior year reserves. The reserve release in 2014 was generated by the Fire and other damage to property and Reinsurance segments.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an aggregate prior-year reserve release of GBP 2.6m (net of reinsurance) in 2014, driven by favourable development in the Fire and other damage to property and Reinsurance segments. A gross prior-year movement figure is not disclosed in the notes; only the net release is stated.
raw_causal_phrases: reserve releases of GBP 2.6m (2013: GBP 0.7m) net of reinsurance were made from prior year reserves.
The reserve release in 2014 was generated by the Fire and other damage to property and Reinsurance segments.
Losses continue to develop, both positively and negatively on these open balances.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The Balance Sheet lists gross 'Claims outstanding' 2013 comparative = GBP 64,958k (used as opening reserves). The notes explicitly state a prior-year reserve release of GBP 2.6m but only give the NET of reinsurance. No gross prior-year movement (Insurance liabilities column) or a prior-year movement table was found, so the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the net figure as explicitly stated in the 'Claims Outstanding' note. Amounts from the segmental analysis were used for premium mix. No claims development triangle or gross prior-year movement reconciliation was located.
